about: A fan-made, offline guide and tracker for all 55 PlayStation 5 trophies of Grand Theft Auto VI. Trophy names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in our own words and names its sources beside it, so you can check where each fact comes from. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — start the story, start the habits
roadmap.text: Play the opening chapter. Two habits pay off for the whole run: scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study new animals through the binoculars as you meet them, because the 100% checklist later asks for 200 vehicle scans and 100 animal studies. Watch for the one moment this guide flags red: during Chapter 1, Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house. Do it when it appears — it may count toward Positive Mental Attitude and it is gone for good once the chapter ends. Keep a manual save at the chapter's start; the game has 15 manual save slots and no mission replay.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2–3 — both characters, money systems open
roadmap.text: From Chapter 2's Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and call your partner in, which unlocks the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best). Chapter 2 also opens the garage purchases (Daily Driver) and the Scooter Bros app (Moses). Chapter 3 brings the heist tools: the Snap Gun for silent jewelry robberies (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) and the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills (Credit Check). Rob as you go — the cash funds garages, spending and registrations, and the robberies themselves feed several trophies at once.

roadmap.title: Chapters 4–5 — finish the story
roadmap.text: Play the story out. Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks the large bank vault robberies: your first vault job also counts as an armored-truck robbery, and escaping its 4-star wanted level with your partner covers Hot Together if you still need it. Keep a save from before the final mission — there is no mission replay and no New Game+. When the credits roll you return to free-roam with everything else still available, and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats.

roadmap.title: Free-roam — the 100% Completion checklist
roadmap.text: Work the checklist that A Long Road asks for. It is more forgiving than it sounds — guides estimate it at roughly 60% of true completion: most side quests and many collectible types are not required, and of the 80 Challenges you need any 70 for the checklist (50 already earns One Last Thing). The parts that must be finished in full are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunting quests. Stunts are the long tail: 250 earns Cunning Stunts, and the checklist wants 300, so keep going.

roadmap.title: Side stories and cleanup — then the platinum
roadmap.text: Finish the character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — note that the named characters' own questlines do not count as stranger strands; Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count, and Yago's Race Against Yago is time-sensitive, so run it when it appears. Five hidden trophies still have no confirmed method at launch; their cards in this guide say so honestly and cite the sources watching them. When the other 54 are earned, Vice Got a Price! completes the set. Total estimate for the platinum: about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough, and no online trophies at all.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. No multiplayer and no DLC are involved — the whole list is single-player, so a single thorough playthrough can earn it.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in this list.
The platinum pops automatically with the last one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as the mission ends and cannot be missed.
steps: Play the opening main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 1 storyline. Chapter trophies can register a little late — this one is reported to pop as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins, so don't worry if it isn't instant at the chapter's last cutscene.
steps: Complete every main mission of Chapter 1.
If it hasn't popped, play into the first mission of Chapter 2.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 storyline. Like the other chapter trophies it is automatic and unmissable, and it may only register once Chapter 3 is under way.
steps: Complete every main mission of Chapter 2.
Play into Chapter 3 if the unlock is delayed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 storyline. Automatic and unmissable; guides report it popping after the opening missions of Chapter 4 rather than on the final cutscene of Chapter 3.
steps: Complete every main mission of Chapter 3.
Continue into Chapter 4 to trigger a delayed unlock.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 storyline, ending with its final main mission, Starting From Zero. Automatic and unmissable.
steps: Complete every main mission of Chapter 4.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final story mission at the end of Chapter 5. Because there is no mission replay, keep one of your manual save slots untouched from just before it — cheap insurance if anything goes wrong on the run.
steps: Keep a manual save before the final mission.
Complete the final mission to end the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during normal story progress and cannot be missed.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy for The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. Automatic as you play the story; it cannot be missed.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy for Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission. It unlocks as the mission completes and cannot be missed.
steps: Reach Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy for Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission. Automatic during the story and unmissable.
steps: Reach Headliners in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy for VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission set around the airport. It unlocks as the mission completes and cannot be missed.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy for Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission late in the game. Automatic and unmissable.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list, and the long one: finish the 100% Completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story — though everything you did during the story already counts toward it. Guides estimate the checklist at roughly 60% of true completion: most side quests and many collectible types are not required, and you need only 70 of the 80 Challenges. The parts that must be done in full are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunting quests. Nothing toward it is missable; it can all be finished in free-roam after the credits.
steps: Finish the story to reveal the checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion).
Complete any 100 optional missions and any 70 of 80 Challenges.
Scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals along the way.
Finish the fully-required sets: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's quests.

sources.name: CryptoGames — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements: Full List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the game's 397 stunts, mixing the four types freely: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track progress per region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and keep going afterwards — the 100% checklist asks for 300.
steps: Pick a stunt type and work its map icons (Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots).
Mix types freely; only the total of 250 matters.
Continue to 300 later for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types, and each one only has to be tried once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your coverage under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most types arrive on their own through the story and the other trophies, so this usually unlocks without a dedicated effort.
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see the 9 types.
Try each type at least once; map activity icons are blue.
Fill any gap in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn the gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 gold medals in total across the ranges. The ranges must also be completed in full for the 100% checklist, so there is no shortcut around them. As a side benefit, range practice raises your Focus stat, which makes Gunslinger easier later.
steps: Visit each shooting range and play its challenges.
Replay a challenge until it scores gold.
Repeat until all 42 challenges are gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, but the trophy only needs a single win per location, so pick the easiest race at each spot. Drone races are also on the 100% checklist's fully-required list.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Win any one race there.
Repeat at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The state offers 40 unique race locations, so you only need to win at half of them — skip any race that gives you trouble and take the win somewhere easier instead.
steps: Enter races from their map icons and win.
Each win must be at a different location.
Stop at 20 different locations won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces you to Cal, he texts you a fishing spot, shown as a purple icon. Follow his short fishing questline and, in the challenge at its end, catch more than he does to beat him.
steps: Complete Feng Shui in Chapter 1 to meet Cal.
Answer his text and go to the purple fishing spot.
Work through his fishing quests and win the final challenge against him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one of the four video games inside the game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 onward; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, runs on arcade machines. Completing a game means finishing all of its levels once; pick whichever suits you.
steps: Use the TV at home (from Chapter 1) or find an arcade machine.
Choose one game and play through all of its levels.
The trophy unlocks when the game is completed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline. She is Lucia-only: during Chapter 3 she calls Lucia and texts her home address in Belville, which marks the strand on the map. The line runs five quests; finish the fifth, her final mission, for the trophy. The strand stays available after the story, so it cannot be missed.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and take Andy's call.
Go to her marked home in Belville to start the strand.
Complete all 5 of her quests, ending with her final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. He is marked in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams, with a green KR icon in Key Lento: dive the shipwrecks with the metal detector and bring him the treasures from 7 wrecks. He becomes unavailable for a stretch of the story but always comes back — this one looks missable and is not.
steps: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, visit Kenton in Key Lento (green KR icon).
Dive each shipwreck and recover its treasure set.
Return the treasures from all 7 wrecks to finish his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. He is marked on the map after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, and his strand runs five quests. Like the other character questlines it remains available after the story ends.
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Start Billy's strand from his map marker.
Complete all 5 quests, ending with his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers — but only some questlines count as stranger strands. The confirmed ones include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; the named characters who have their own trophies (Andy, Billy, Tyrone and the others) do not count toward this one. Check the trophy tracker after finishing a strand to confirm it registered. One warning: Yago's strand mission Race Against Yago is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) — run it when it appears rather than leaving it for later.
steps: Start stranger strands from their map markers as they appear.
Prioritise the confirmed strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete.
Do Race Against Yago as soon as it appears.
Finish 8 strands in total.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's car-theft questline. After Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS you deliver him a first car, and he gives you Randy's Wish List: 16 specific sports cars to steal and bring to him (green RK icon in west Vice City). Scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you whether it is on his list. Delivering cars undamaged pays better, but every delivery counts.
steps: Complete Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3.
Use the WAiNK app to check cars against Randy's Wish List.
Deliver all 16 listed cars to Randy in west Vice City.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, playing as Jason. After Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty, Tyrone sends you against the Synthetic Labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter objectives (purple map markers). Destroy the labs he points you at, and he will offer the follow-up mission Spin On This — completing it earns the trophy.
steps: Play as Jason and complete Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs at the purple markers (Take Out Kitty Litter).
Accept and complete Tyrone's follow-up mission, Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations (tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations); meditating with both characters present counts double, so bring your partner. This is the game's one potentially missable trophy: in Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, Lucia walks to the balcony at Jason's house to meditate — follow her and accept. That moment is unmarked, vanishes when Chapter 1 ends, and guides disagree on whether it is required; do it to be safe. The last spot needs both characters out together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house and accept the meditation.
Visit each spot with both characters where possible (counts double).
Meditate at all 18 spots across the 10 locations.

sources.name: CryptoGames — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements: Full List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret Vogel's hunting request. Bret is Jason-only: he texts after Chapter 2's Coffee Break and his first quest, Veteran Hunted, starts in Lummox County. His hunting requests run through the Target Decks (Map > Activities > Target Deck) — the trophy is for bringing him the unique animal he asks for. His full set of 15 Target Decks is also required for 100% completion, and he rewards you with the unique Killtelligence SM-69 rifle along the way.
steps: Play as Jason and answer Bret's text after Coffee Break (Chapter 2).
Start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Work his Target Deck requests and deliver the unique animal.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect every card in any 3 full Collectible Card sets. The game has 18 sets in total, so you can choose the three shortest or most convenient sets and ignore the rest — only completed sets count, not individual cards.
steps: Pick a card set and collect all of its cards in the world.
Finish any 3 complete sets.
Track found cards under your collections progress.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations: hold Up on the D-pad and press R1 at a scannable spot. The scannables include 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — more than 100 exist in total, so any 100 scans earn the trophy.
steps: Hold Up and press R1 to scan with the WAiNK app.
Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags as you explore.
Reach 100 scanned locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 Challenges, tracked under Progress > Challenges. Since the 100% checklist later asks for 70 of 80, this trophy normally arrives on the way there — pick off the quick challenges first and leave the grindy ones for the checklist push.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see the 80 challenges.
Complete the quickest ones first.
Reach 50 completed challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone on the map. This is only possible once both characters can free-roam together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call your partner in first (hold Right + Triangle). A reliable escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: break line of sight, wait in the tunnel, then leave the zone. The Chapter 4 bank vault robbery also triggers this naturally if you still need it.
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner in.
Commit crimes together until you reach 4 stars.
Break line of sight and leave the red heat zone, e.g. via the train tunnel north of Ambrosia.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner called in, rob 3 shops in a row while your wanted level stays up the whole time — the stars must keep flashing between shops; if they turn solid, the chain resets. The three jewelry stores in northern Vice City make a neat set once Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs has opened them. Don't panic if nothing pops at the third shop: the unlock can arrive about 30 seconds late.
steps: Call your partner in (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break).
Rob a shop and move straight to the next while the wanted level is still flashing.
Chain 3 shops without the wanted level dropping.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — hold Up, then press R1 on a vehicle you haven't scanned. You don't need to drive or own them, so standing by busy traffic and scanning everything that passes works well. There are 557 vehicles in the game, and the 100% checklist eventually wants 200 base models scanned, so starting this habit in Chapter 1 pays off twice.
steps: Hold Up, then press R1 to scan vehicles with the WAiNK app.
Scan parked and passing vehicles you haven't discovered yet.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one Combat Focus activation (press L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar). It only counts on gang enemies — not police, soldiers or civilians. Prepare first: raise your Focus level with food and drink, a shower, or Adrenaline, then trigger it with an assault rifle against a grouped gang operation or illegal operation where five targets are close together.
steps: Raise your Focus (eat, drink, shower, or use Adrenaline).
Find a group of 5+ gang enemies, e.g. at an illegal operation.
Aim, press L3 + R3, and take down 5 before the bar empties.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA airport — the planes at gates E3 and E4 are the easy targets; planes parked on the open airfield do not count. Get into the cockpit, back the plane out, take off and fly roughly a kilometre away. The unlock can be delayed, so keep flying rather than landing straight away.
steps: Go to VCIA and find a passenger plane docked at a gate bridge (E3/E4).
Enter the cockpit and taxi out.
Take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause some damage with it. The tanks sit on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-western edge of the map in Mariana County. Save before you go in — the base is hostile — then climb in and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
steps: Save your game, then head to Mile Zero Air Station (south-west island, Mariana County).
Reach a Rhino tank on the south side of the base.
Get in and fire on enemies until it unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store's safe without anyone noticing. You need the Snap Gun from Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: use it on the store's back door, because kicking the door triggers the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room, open the safe, take the money and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
steps: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3).
Enter a jewelry store through its back door using the Snap Gun.
Find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, and leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away. The large vault robberies are unlocked by the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to its bank, slip into the vault while it is open, and bring your partner — they can carry a second money bag. Expect an instant 4-star wanted level and up to about $205,000 per bank. There are 8 vaults in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them; after Yasmani's earlier quests he also sells van tips for $10,000.
steps: Complete the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock vault robberies.
Tail a security van to a bank and enter the vault while it is open, partner in tow.
Escape the 4-star wanted level; repeat at 5 different banks.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. The comfortable route is automatic: the first bank vault robbery in Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… counts as an armored truck robbery too, so this pops alongside Maximum Withdrawal progress. Earlier in the game you can do it manually — block a roaming armored truck near a bank, blow its rear doors with a sticky bomb, grab the cash and lose the wanted level.
steps: Option A: rob your first bank vault in Chapter 4's optional mission — it counts automatically.
Option B: block an armored truck, sticky-bomb the rear doors, take the cash.
Escape the red heat zone either way.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal the entire map of Leonida by clearing all of its fog. The fastest method is a plane: fly systematic sweeps over the blacked-out areas until no fog remains anywhere. It pairs naturally with the stunt flights and the WAiNK landmark scans.
steps: Take a plane and fly over the fogged areas of the map.
Sweep region by region until the whole map is revealed.
Check the map for any remaining fog patches.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation owned by each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total, and your per-gang progress is tracked under Progress > Gangs — the trophy needs one robbery per gang, while the 100% checklist eventually asks for all 39.
steps: Open Progress > Gangs to see the 9 gangs.
Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang.
Repeat until all 9 gangs have been robbed once.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Honest status: no confirmed method exists for this trophy yet. The main guides list its trigger as unknown at launch, and the description is the only lead — it points to drinking a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach. Treat beachfront bars on Ocean Beach as places to experiment, and check the cited sources as their guides are updated; this card will not invent a method that isn't confirmed.
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the trigger is currently unknown.
Lead from the description: try cocktail spots overlooking Ocean Beach.
Re-check the cited guides as launch-week discoveries land.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Honest status: no confirmed method exists for this trophy yet — the main guides list it as currently unknown. The description suggests stealing a car from inside a vehicle showroom and driving it out through the glass, but that reading is unconfirmed, so treat showrooms as an experiment rather than a plan.
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the trigger is currently unknown.
Lead from the description: a vehicle showroom, exited by smashing out in a car.
Re-check the cited guides as methods are confirmed.

sources.name: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Clear out the valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — the Kolt & Associates alley, which is a gang operation you also visit in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the contents of the office safe (blow it open with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police. Anything you leave behind can be collected on a later visit because the operation respawns, so this is not missable.
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (visited in Chapter 2's Hit Kingpin Bowling).
Take the luxury watch (south-east office) and the Gutterball Moreland 850 (north-east corner).
Blow the office safe with sticky bombs and take its contents.
Escape the police to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time — check the stat under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength. Once the two can be out together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), buy a gym or fitness club membership and train: your partner trains alongside you automatically, so both Strength bars climb together.
steps: Wait until both characters can free-roam together (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2).
Buy a gym/fitness club membership.
Train together until both Jason and Lucia sit at maximum Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile — stealthy finishes, incapacitations and kills all feed the counter, which is also shown in the trophy list itself. The profile grades run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable; note that Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid the most extreme behaviour if you care about the label. For most players this fills in passively across the robberies and encounters the other trophies already demand.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile HUD notifications in Settings > Display to watch progress.
Play robberies and encounters; takedowns of every kind count.
Reach 500 counted actions (avoid Irredeemable — it cannot be undone).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honest status: no confirmed method exists for this trophy yet. Guides list it as unknown at launch; the one circulating belief is that it connects to the Payday Loans store from the prologue and some second-chance moment there — but that is unconfirmed, so don't build your route around it.
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the trigger is currently unknown.
Unconfirmed belief: something at the prologue's Payday Loans store, on a second attempt.
Re-check the cited guides as methods are confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Honest status: no confirmed method exists for this trophy yet. It is believed to belong to a UFO-related questline — guides list the trigger as unknown at launch, so treat UFO sightings and related stranger content as leads to follow, not as a confirmed route.
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the trigger is currently unknown.
Unconfirmed belief: a UFO-related questline.
Re-check the cited guides as methods are confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Honest status: no confirmed method exists for this trophy yet. The description and the bowling wordplay suggest knocking enemies down with a melee drive-by from a motorcycle, and that is the belief guides currently record — but the exact requirement is unconfirmed at launch.
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the trigger is currently unknown.
Unconfirmed belief: melee drive-by knockdowns from a motorcycle.
Re-check the cited guides as methods are confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your fences. The system opens with Chapter 3's Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer: rob banks and Payday Loans stores, take the marked bills, and deliver them to a fence — Yasmani pays the best rates. The big bank vault robberies from Chapter 4 hand over large amounts at once, which speeds this up considerably.
steps: Complete Credit Check (Chapter 3) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans stores for Marked Bills.
Sell the bills to a fence (Yasmani pays most) until $250,000 is laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops in the game. It doesn't need to be one purchase or one store — every dollar in every shop counts. Guns, car modifications and tattoos are the fastest money sinks once the robbery income starts flowing.
steps: Earn money from robberies and missions.
Spend across any shops — guns, car mods and tattoos burn cash fastest.
Reach $100,000 total spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, which becomes available after Chapter 2's Daily Driver. The full set costs about $160,000. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count toward this — only the 8 bought ones do. Buy them before heavy vehicle registering, since each registered car needs a garage space.
steps: Unlock the Vice City Real Estate phone app (after Daily Driver, Chapter 2).
Save roughly $160,000 from robberies and missions.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Take a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. Every registration needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and feed the app cheap cars. From Chapter 3, cars fitted with a standard tracker can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
steps: Get the Scooter Bros app (after the Chapter 2 mission Moses).
Buy garage space first (see Little Boxes).
Bring stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn: Respray, then Register — 10 times.
